reviews.title: perfect quality, but palm grip is iffy
reviews.comment: no problems, but palm grip is probably not comfortable. i use palm grip and cannot get my ring finger on the side of the mouse, so it just rests on top awkwardly. Still miles better than the rival 710 i had. it does reduce sweat for palm grip though.

reviews.title: perfect
reviews.comment: Great for my gaming and school work it needs some updating to work bluetooth without interruptions but after all configurations are made it works amazingly. short charge time compared  to how much battery life it has being left on which is about 4 days in and out of use. the usb-c makes it easy to plug in to anything other then the computer to get a charge at all.
